## What this changes

## The landing checklist

- [ ] `spark help` has a line for it (if it is a command)
- [ ] there is a `spark <verb>` (if it is a choice) -- not just a
      `site.env` key
- [ ] there is a `spark check` row (if it is a promise the machine makes)
- [ ] README.md / INSTALL.md / CHEATSHEET.txt / CHANGELOG.md updated
- [ ] the gate is green locally (see AGENTS.md / CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] the privacy NOTICE was seen (a fork has no personal word list) and
      no personal, machine, or project name was added
- [ ] CREDITS.md updated, if a pin or a model row changed
